Item.Name: EQUIPMENT_TYPE
Item.Hint: Enter the equipment type, or use [LISTVAL].

Trigger.Name: KEY-NEXT-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
 if (:ctrl_blk_1.equipment_type is not null) then
 begin
 select substr(mc.code_desc,1,20)
 into :ctrl_blk_1.equipment_desc
 from equip_master_codes mc
 where mc.code_type = 'EQUIP'
 and mc.code = :ctrl_blk_1.equipment_type;
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 show_error ('1306');
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 GO_ITEM ('equipment_id');
 else
 GO_ITEM ('start_date');
 end if;
end;

Item.Name: EQUIPMENT_ID
Item.Hint: Enter the equipment ID, or use [LISTVAL].

Trigger.Name: KEY-NEXT-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
 execute_trigger ('validate_field');
 check_package_failure;
 if (:ctrl_blk_1.equipment_id is not null) then
 begin
 GO_ITEM ('equipment_reference');
 if (:ctrl_blk_1.equipment_reference is null) then
 begin
 select e.equip_reference
 into :ctrl_blk_1.equipment_reference
 from equipment e
 where e.equip_type = :ctrl_blk_1.equipment_type
 and e.equip_id = :ctrl_blk_1.equipment_id
 and e.chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 exception
 when too_many_rows then
 :ctrl_blk_1.equipment_reference := null;
 list_values;
 end;
 end if;
 end;
 else
 GO_ITEM ('start_date');
 end if;
end;

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
 if(:ctrl_blk_1.equipment_id is not null) then
 begin
 select 'X' into :global.x from equipment e
 where e.equip_id = :ctrl_blk_1.equipment_id
 and e.equip_type = :ctrl_blk_1.equipment_type
 and e.chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 /* modified by HCL Consulting */
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 show_error ('1306');
 check_package_failure;
 when others then null;
 end;
 end if;
end;

Trigger.Name: KEY-NEXT-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
 if (:ctrl_blk_1.start_date is not null) then
 GO_ITEM ('end_date');
 else
 go_block ('display_data');
 :SYSTEM.message_level :=5;
 execute_query;
 go_record ('1');
 :SYSTEM.message_level :=0;
 if (:display_data.equip_reference is null) then
 go_block ('ctrl_blk_1');
 GO_ITEM ('equipment_type');
 show_error ('1369');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 end if;
 exception when value_error then null;
end;

Trigger.Name: KEY-NEXT-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
 if (:ctrl_blk_1.end_date is not null) then
 if (:ctrl_blk_1.end_date < :ctrl_blk_1.start_date) then
 show_error ('8050');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 end if;
 go_block ('display_data');
 :SYSTEM.message_level :=5;
 execute_query;
 go_record ('1');
 :SYSTEM.message_level :=0;
 if (:display_data.equip_reference is null) then
 go_block ('ctrl_blk_1');
 GO_ITEM ('equipment_type');
 show_error ('1369');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 exception when value_error then null;
end;

Block.Name: DISPLAY_DATA
Block.WhereClause: where equipment_event.equip_reference in (select e.equip_reference from equipment e where (:ctrl_blk_1.equipment_type is null or :ctrl_blk_1.equipment_type = e.equip_type) and (:ctrl_blk_1.equipment_id is null or :ctrl_blk_1.equipment_id = e.equip_id) and (:ctrl_blk_1.equipment_reference is null or :ctrl_blk_1.equipment_reference = e.equip_reference) and :GLOBAL.chapter_id = e.chapter_id) and equipment_event.service_code is not null and (:ctrl_blk_1.start_date is null or trunc(:ctrl_blk_1.start_date) <= equipment_event.service_start) and (:ctrl_blk_1.end_date is null or :ctrl_blk_1.end_date >= trunc(equipment_event.service_start))
Block.OrderByClause: order by equipment_event.equip_reference, equipment_event.service_code, equipment_event.service_start desc

Trigger.Name: POST-QUERY
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 --v_local_time date;

begin
 select e.equip_type, e.equip_id, e.status
 into :display_data.equip_type, :display_data.equip_id,
 :display_data.equip_status
 from equipment e
 where e.equip_reference = :display_data.equip_reference
 and e.chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 /* modified by HCL Consulting */
 :display_data.dummy1 := ' ';
 select substr(mc.code_desc,1,16) into :display_data.s_service_desc
 from equipment_event ee, equip_master_codes mc
 where ee.event_reference = :display_data.event_reference
 and mc.code_type = 'SRV'
 and mc.code = ee.service_code;
 
 /* modified for timezone conversion starts*/
 
 if is_timezone_enabled then
 
 if :display_data.service_start is not null then
 -- v_local_time := null;
 --- Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,:display_data.service_start, v_local_time);
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,:display_data.service_start, :display_data.service_start);
 --:display_data.service_start := v_local_time;
 end if;
 
 if :display_data.service_end is not null then
 --v_local_time := null;
 --Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,:display_data.service_end, v_local_time);
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,:display_data.service_end, :display_data.service_end);
 --:display_data.service_end := v_local_time;
 end if;
 --else
 --:display_data.service_start := :display_data.service_start;
 --:display_data.service_end := :display_data.service_end;
 end if;
 /* modified for timezone conversion ends*/
end;

RecordGroup.Name: CTRL_BLK_1_EQUIPMENT_T_LOV0
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery: select distinct (e.equip_type), substr(mc.code_desc,1,20) from equipment e, equip_master_codes mc where mc.code_type = 'EQUIP' and mc.code = e.equip_type and e.chapter_id = :ctrl_blk_1.s_chapter_id /* modified by hcl consulting */

RecordGroup.Name: CTRL_BLK_1_EQUIPMENT_I_LOV1
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery: select e.equip_id, e.equip_reference, substr(decode(least(nvl(e.first_production_date, trunc(sysdate)+1), trunc(sysdate)+1), trunc(sysdate)+1, 'Not yet in service.', 'Service from: '||to_char(e.first_production_date, 'MM-DD-YY')||' to: '||nvl(to_char(e.last_production_date, 'MM-DD-YY'), 'Present')),1,38) from equipment e where e.equip_type = :ctrl_blk_1.equipment_type and e.chapter_id = :ctrl_blk_1.s_chapter_id order by decode(least(nvl(e.first_production_date, trunc(sysdate)+1), trunc(sysdate)+1), trunc(sysdate)+1, '2', decode(least(nvl(e.last_production_date, trunc(sysdate)), trunc(sysdate)), trunc(sysdate), '1', '3')), e.equip_id

RecordGroup.Name: CTRL_BLK_1_EQUIPMENT_R_LOV2
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery: select e.equip_reference, substr(decode(least(nvl(e.first_production_date, trunc(sysdate)+1), trunc(sysdate)+1), trunc(sysdate)+1, 'Not yet in service', 'Service from: ' ||to_char(e.first_production_date, 'MM-DD-YY')||' to: '||nvl(to_char(e.last_production_date, 'MM-DD-YY'), 'Present')),1,38) from equipment e where e.equip_id = :ctrl_blk_1.equipment_id and e.equip_type = :ctrl_blk_1.equipment_type and e.chapter_id = :ctrl_blk_1.s_chapter_id
